The integration of these targets suggests a potential mechanism by which Gallomyrtucommulone D may modulate VMRC-LCP activity, possibly through the inhibition of its downstream targets. The evidence implies a direct or indirect relationship between Gallomyrtucommulone D and VMRC-LCP, mediated by Annexin A1 and the brominated compound. The pathway highlights a possible role for Annexin A1 in mediating the effects of Gallomyrtucommulone D on VMRC-LCP, though further experimental validation is needed to confirm the exact nature of this interaction.
